body:
Using ocean-only MAC `lwp` broke the observation pipeline, this PR fixes it. 

Changes
- `compute_mean_and_stddev` is now NaN-aware. A masked field keeps NaN at latitudes with no ocean, which made the normalization constants NaN and erased the whole variable, surfacing later as an empty observation.
- The observation's coverage mask is now applied to the corresponding model diagnostics. This previously caused issues where ocean-only MAC `lwp` was silently being compared to ocean+land model output. We could use a static ocean mask but MAC coverage also varies with time, so there would still be a mismatch. This shared mask should live upstream in ClimaCalibrate. There is also probably a better way of generating the mask.
title: Fix the AMIP zonal-mean observation pipeline for masked observations
